Attachment — Edit

The Edit Attachment form allows you to rename an existing attachment without re-uploading the file.

This is useful when you need to correct a filename or make it more descriptive for easier identification.

The form contains the following field:

Date

The date when this attachment was uploaded or created.

This date helps track when documents were added to the system for audit purposes.

Name

The filename of the attached document. This helps identify the attachment content.

Attachments can include supporting documents like receipts, contracts, or correspondence.
